scope: Four real Hermes changes selected for semantic similarity around capacity-aware compaction pressure; existing cases and synthesis were not modified.

cases.subject: fix(compress): reserve output tokens in the compaction threshold
cases.problem: The provider's output reservation and the compressor's input threshold use the same context window, but the threshold was derived from the nominal window.

before_after.after: effective_input = context_length - normalized_positive_max_tokens; threshold = policy(effective_input), with safe handling of non-positive effective input

case_actions.goal: Identify that downstream output capacity is carved from the same shared window
Convert optional or malformed max_tokens at the boundary
Apply threshold and small-window guards to residual input capacity
Carry the reservation from agent construction and through update_model
Partition no reservation, valid reservation, malformed input, and reservation>=window

guards: If max_tokens is absent or invalid, preserve no-reservation compatibility
If residual capacity is non-positive, do not install a non-positive threshold
validation_oracles: constructor does not crash for malformed forwarded values

cases.subject: fix(agent): cap compaction threshold floor at 85% of the context window
cases.problem: A minimum-context floor can bind below the nominal-window equality case and leave only a sliver of output room, so reactive overflow protection may never run or may be too late.

before_after.before: Only floor>=effective_window triggered the 85% fallback; at 65536 the floor 64000 passed through.
before_after.after: When the floor, rather than explicit percentage, is binding, cap it at 85% of effective input; preserve explicit threshold_percent above 85% as user intent.

case_actions.goal: Partition floor-bound, percentage-bound, and degenerate-window regimes
Apply a safety cap only to the implicit minimum floor
Do not override an explicit user percentage above the cap
Test near-minimum, below-cap-floor, and explicit-high cases

guards: Apply cap only if the floor is the binding term
Keep a positive threshold even when effective capacity is tiny

cases.subject: fix(compression): cap the protected tail at 20% of the context window
cases.problem: A fixed minimum protected tail plus a 1.5x whole-row overrun can consume the entire small context window, leaving no reclaimable middle.

before_after.before: Fixed lean floor/cap and 1.5*tail budget were independent of context_length.
before_after.after: Optional tail budget and soft ceiling are bounded by TAIL_MAX_CONTEXT_FRACTION=0.20 of the active context; required anchors/tool groups may explicitly overrun.

case_actions.goal: Detect that fixed retention consumes a disproportionate share on small windows
Scale optional retained-tail budget by active context capacity
Apply the same envelope to boundary walking and pressure demotion
Allow required anchors and atomic tool groups to remain intact
Prove a real compressible middle on small contexts and compatibility on large contexts

guards: Do not violate required anchor/tool-group atomicity
Do not change large-window behavior where the old clamp already fits

cases.subject: refactor(compression): one trigger derivation for update_model and the switch-guard preview
cases.problem: A preview path and the state-installation path duplicated trigger math, allowing a warning to quote a number different from the threshold actually installed after a model/provider switch.

before_after.before: preview_threshold_tokens and update_model independently resolved percentage, floor, threshold, and cap.
before_after.after: Pure _derive_trigger is shared; preview projects its threshold and update_model installs all returned derived values. Runtime-only auxiliary cap remains a separate seam.

case_actions.goal: Find duplicated policy derivation across preview and installation paths
Create one pure derivation seam for shared inputs
Keep runtime-specific auxiliary summarizer feasibility outside model trigger derivation
Check switch guard text and cap-binding presentation against installed threshold

guards: Only centralize values with identical model/window inputs
Do not force runtime-dependent auxiliary caps into a pure model policy
validation_oracles: switch guard quotes cap when cap binds
no cap note when ratio is lower

rejected_alignments.reason: recovery cooldown and fallback ladder change failure handling, not capacity derivation
content validity/failure classification, not capacity pressure

validation.upstream_tests: not yet run in this extraction run
